punchline: What broke SN8's landing could be written in one concrete sentence: the methane tank pressure was low.
thirty_sec: On 9 December 2020 the Starship prototype SN8 reached 12.5 kilometres and exploded on landing because of low methane tank pressure. On 5 May 2021 SN15 landed safely, and the first full-stack flight on 20 April 2023 ended at about 39 kilometres.
question: Can you write the cause of your last stalled piece of work in one concrete sentence, and what will you change on the next attempt?
key_contrast: One sentence of cause instead of a vague 'it went badly.'
